_about: Part of the reference catalogue: worked examples and exercises with data from Box, Hunter and Hunter, Statistics for
Experimenters (1978), for testing that software reproduces them. source: the citation, with what was read and when.
experiments: each example or exercise with data (factors, responses, runs exactly as printed, in the printed order),
where it is printed, and expected: every number the book prints for it, as printed text, with where it is printed (a
page and a quotation) and check: how to recompute it, or manual, the reason it is not recomputed. A check with a
disagreement records a number known not to reproduce and why. not_captured: what in these chapters is not an
tests/test_reference_catalogue.py recomputes every number that has a check.

source.title: Statistics for Experimenters: An Introduction to Design, Data Analysis, and Model Building
source.cite: Box, G. E. P., Hunter, W. G. and Hunter, J. S. (1978), Statistics for Experimenters, Wiley
source.read: 2026-10-14, from scans of the front matter and chapters 1 to 3; tables taken from the text layer and checked against the totals and averages the book prints; Table 2.3's circled entries, one average of Table 2.2 and Exercise 2.6 read from the page image
source.rights: The book is protected by copyright (© 1978 John Wiley & Sons, Inc.) and is not reproduced here. This file holds facts it reports (numbers, layouts, data) and short quotations that locate each one, for citation and for checking software. The MIT licence of process-improve does not extend to them.
